text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT P0 — GCP europe-west2 partial network instability affecting Private-connected workloads (VPN/Interconnect). Multiple customer reports of DNS failures and TCP timeouts. Auto-paged on-call. Links: https://status.cloud.google.com/ (reported) :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Paging alice (primary on-call), bob (networking) — escalation in 2 min if not acknowledged.

alice (oncall-sre): Acked. I'm jumping in. Quick ask: which customers and what symptoms?

dave (prod-support): Customer: "FinSense" (private via Cloud VPN to europe-west2) reporting 502s from their internal app -> our private gateway. Also "RetailMax" seeing intermittent DNS NXDOMAINs from our VPC resolvers. Tickets opened: #4521, #4523.

bob (networking): GCP status shows "Network — Europe-west2 — Intermittent connectivity" and we see BGP flap events on our Cloud Interconnect peering. Suspect partial route withdrawal to some prefixes. https://status.cloud.google.com/incidents/xxxxx

carol (infra): Observability: increased 5xx and connection resets on private-gateway-proxies in west-eu cluster. KV cache misses spiked as failover attempts started. Logs (snippet):
```
2026-03-10T10:12:03Z proxy-1 europe-west2 ERR dial tcp 10.8.0.1:443: i/o timeout
2026-03-10T10:12:05Z proxy-1 europe-west2 WARN resolver: lookup failed for customer-internal.svc.cluster.local: dial tcp 169.254.20.10:53: i/o timeout
```

frank (private-deployments): Confirming private-control-plane heartbeats lost for customers with tunnels anchored in europe-west2. On-prem agents show TCP retransmits toward our NAT IP ranges.

alice (oncall-sre): Initial mitigation plan: 1) Enable traffic reroute policy to europe-west1 for affected routes 2) Shorten DNS TTL for private control plane to 30s 3) Kick a canary failover for one non-critical customer to validate. Who can run the route change?

bob (networking): I can do route re-announce from our control plane/FR region. Will also open a BGP session check with GCP peering team. Command I'll run (brief):
```
bgpctl announce prefix 10.20.0.0/16 --from-region europe-west1 --community redwood:fallback
redwoodctl routing set --policy emergency --from-region europe-west1 --to-target private-gateways
```

eve (customer-success): Please post a short customer-facing blurb we can send to impacted customers. They need ETA and mitigation steps.

alice (oncall-sre): Draft blurb: "We're seeing partial network instability in the europe-west2 GCP region impacting some Private deployments. Our engineers are rerouting traffic to europe-west1 and applying DNS TTL changes. We expect partial relief within 30-60 minutes. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary." Thoughts?

dave (prod-support): Fine. I'll send that to FinSense and RetailMax and attach our incident runbook link.

bob (networking): Re-announce started. Watching control plane: BGP sessions re-established from europe-west1 → some prefixes now reachable. Still seeing flaps for a subset of crates. GCP has acknowledged maintenance affecting peering fabric — ticket GCP-98765.

carol (infra): Canary failover started for dev-tenant-12. Observing connection rebinds and resolution of DNS for that tenant within 90s. Metrics: latency and error rates trending down for canary.

alice (oncall-sre): Good. Prioritize customers with active SLAs: FinSense (P1), RetailMax (P2). Assigning frank to coordinate customer-specific reroute for FinSense.

frank (private-deployments): On it. For FinSense I'm initiating manual tunnel switch to europe-west1 endpoint and bumping local route priority. Steps I ran:
```
# on customer's on-prem gateway
set route 10.20.0.0/16 preference 100 via 35.199.48.12
# update our control plane
redwoodctl private route update --customer finsense --primary-region europe-west1
```

dave (prod-support): FinSense confirms improved connectivity after manual switch. They report reduced 502s and successful DNS resolution.

bob (networking): GCP estimating full fabric stability in ~45 mins. They'll keep us updated. If fabric doesn't stabilize we'll keep fallback re-announcements.

alice (oncall-sre): Real-time mitigation checklist (so we have single source):
- reroute affected prefixes to europe-west1 (in progress)
- set private-control-plane DNS TTL to 30s (carol)
- enable aggressive retry/backoff in private agents for 10m window (frank)
- notify customers and provide manual switch steps (dave/eve)
- keep status page updated (ops)

carol (infra): DNS TTL lowered and propagated. Agent retry flags toggled for impacted pools.

eve (customer-success): Sent customer blurb and manual steps to impacted customers. Tagging support for follow-ups.

alice (oncall-sre): After 50 minutes: GCP reports reduced flap rate and our metrics show majority of traffic back to normal. Remaining small set of prefixes still flapping — keeping fallback re-announces for them.

bob (networking): Confirmed: BGP flap count down from 120/hr to 3/hr. GCP support says they completed maintenance and are monitoring. We'll keep re-announce until 2 hours of stability.

frank (private-deployments): Handing customer-level followups to prod-support. I'll stay on-call for further config changes for the next hour.

alice (oncall-sre): Handing off primary watch to bob (networking) for overnight monitoring. Summary: reroutes applied, DNS TTL shortened, manual customer switches done where needed, GCP reports resolved but will monitor. If anything changes re-alert. Handoff notes: see runbook link and ticket GCP-98765. :white_check_mark:

bob (networking): Acknowledged. Taking over. I'll keep incident pinned and update if we see regression.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — reduced severity to P1 (under observation). Follow-up postmortem requested; assign to alice and bob.

alice (oncall-sre): Will draft postmortem tomorrow focusing on: why control-plane resolvers timed out, TTL and fallback automation gaps, and quicker automated region failover.

dave (prod-support): Closing customer-facing update: "Issues largely mitigated via cross-region routing. We'll follow up with RCA and preventive measures."

eve (customer-success): Customers acknowledged receipt, no new escalations.

bob (networking): Leaving final note: keep BGP session alerts for europe-west2 on high-sensitivity for next 24h.

alice (oncall-sre): Thanks all — handoff complete.

(End of thread)
